grader.scenario: Mobile VoLTE calls dropping immediately upon handover from Wi-Fi to cellular; 6 faults (poor)
grader.notes: Poor call marked by dead air breaches, failed verification, failed personalization, failed probing, rude remarks, and unverified resolution, alongside handled empathy.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net mobile technical faults' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
